capabilities: dock external desktop windows into tabs, split panes, and sidebars
capture windows by drag-and-drop, crosshair picker, or a searchable running-window list
pin applications as icons in the left ribbon
hide and restore docked windows automatically when switching tabs or closing Obsidian
compile a local Win32 helper executable on first launch
disambiguation: Not related to Docker containers; it embeds external desktop windows into the Obsidian workspace.
extras: Windows desktop only; relies on native Win32 and DWM APIs and compiles Win32Helper.exe locally with the built-in .NET Framework C# compiler on first launch. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is bilingual (English and Chinese) and includes BRAT and manual installation instructions.
problem: Obsidian cannot display external desktop applications inside its workspace, so users must switch away from their notes to use other apps.
summary: Windows-only plugin that docks external desktop applications such as WeChat, Edge, or terminals into Obsidian tabs, split panes, and sidebars.
